purpose: Internal turnout source package inventory for Civic Result Maps. This file is not rendered in the app.
notes: Loaded packages are already represented in native ETL configs and promoted database turnout rows.
Missing requests identify the turnout denominator data needed before turnout-based screening can be enabled.
Do not use unofficial turnout data. Each new package must point to an official source artifact stored in this repository.
VerifiedVoting records are contextual election-equipment and audit provenance only; they must not be used as turnout denominators.

loadedPackages.name: Ohio

turnoutSource.sourceTitle: Ohio official statewide races precinct-level workbook

caveats: Uses the President and Vice President sheet's Registered Voters and Ballots Counted fields.

turnoutSource.sourceTitle: Pennsylvania DOS vote history and voter registration summary

loadedPackages.name: South Carolina

turnoutSource.sourceTitle: SC VREMS 2024 General Election voter-history county statistics

denominatorSource.sourceTitle: SC VREMS printed registration-list voter-history denominator

caveats: The SC VREMS source page says registration numbers include voters printed on election lists: all active voters plus some inactive voters. Rows are warning-required and should not be treated as active-registration denominators.
The VREMS statewide summary includes an unassigned/null-county row with 2 registered voters and 1 participating voter; the normalized artifact keeps only the 46 county rows for joins.

loadedPackages.name: Wisconsin
loadedPackages.authority: U.S. Election Assistance Commission; Wisconsin Elections Commission ward results provide result/review rows

turnoutSource.sourceTitle: U.S. EAC 2024 EAVS V2 Wisconsin jurisdiction turnout fallback

denominatorSource.sourceTitle: U.S. EAC 2024 EAVS V2 Wisconsin registered-voter denominator

caveats: EAC F1a Total Voters is not identical to WEC presidential contest total votes.
WEC remains the official source for Wisconsin presidential result rows; EAC is the statewide turnout fallback.

loadedPackages.name: West Virginia

turnoutSource.sourceTitle: West Virginia SOS official county detail XML VoterTurnout rows

denominatorSource.sourceTitle: West Virginia SOS county detail XML totalVoters field

caveats: Turnout rows are precinct-level VoterTurnout rows inside official county detail.xml reports.
The current map package includes county geometry only; official precinct boundary geometry was not identified in this package.
